\chapter{Return to One Fictional Date Repair}
\label{ch:pa-date-repair-r4}
\hlchaptermodality{171}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can retrieve the already-taught one-mark date-form repair after a long gap, with the fictional bank visible and without claiming scored A1 writing.}

Locate and repair only the missing slash or label dot in two familiar fictional dates without adding new Punjabi.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਤਾਰੀਖ਼}: \_\_/\_\_/\_\_\_\_ (one familiar …)}{ਤਾਰੀਖ਼: \_\_/\_\_/\_\_\_\_ (one familiar …)}]{One old date-form repair}

\label{lesson:PA-R171-date-repair-again}



\begin{quote}
The old bank is still here: \textbf{\pa{ਕ}} chooses A \textbf{\pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}, and \textbf{\pa{ਖ}} chooses B \textbf{\pa{੨੫}/\pa{੦੨}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. The label is \textbf{\pa{ਤਾਰੀਖ਼}}. Check one dimension at a time: selector, day, month, year, slash marks, then label spelling and spacing.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Keep the bank visible. For \textbf{\pa{ਕ}}, the printed value \textbf{\pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧੨੦੨੫}} lacks only one slash. Copy it with that slash after \textbf{\pa{੦੧}}: \textbf{\pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. Do not change any digit. For \textbf{\pa{ਖ}}, the value in \textbf{\pa{ਤਾਰੀਖ}: \pa{੨੫}/\pa{੦੨}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}} is already right; copy only the repaired label \textbf{\pa{ਤਾਰੀਖ਼}} with its final dot beneath \textbf{\pa{ਖ਼}}. Leave the date untouched and keep the space after the colon.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Cover the two repairs for a few seconds. Point to the one missing mark in each, then uncover the bank and compare. If one mark differs, repair that mark alone. The model stays available; this is not independent timed writing.
\end{tcolorbox}
